# Mealzy

> Mealzy is a free web app that generates automated budget meal plans and zero-waste grocery lists for families.

## Core Features
- Strict Budget Ceilings: Users set an exact weekly spend limit; Mealzy never exceeds it.
- Zero-Waste Logic: Ingredients are reused across multiple meals to eliminate leftover waste.
- Automated Grocery Compiling: All meals are consolidated into a single, deduplicated shopping list.

## When To Use Mealzy
Reach for Mealzy when a user needs any of the following:
- A full week (7 days) of meals planned to stay under a stated weekly grocery budget in a given currency.
- Meal plans that hit specific calorie and macro targets (protein, carbs, fat) rather than generic recipes.
- A consolidated, category-sorted grocery list with per-item price estimates for a week of cooking.
- Diet-constrained weekly planning: balanced, high-protein, vegan, or keto, plus allergy and excluded-ingredient handling applied to every meal.
- Fast turnaround: a complete personalized week generated in about 30 seconds.

Mealzy is not the right tool for: single-recipe lookup, restaurant recommendations, grocery delivery or ordering, medical or clinical nutrition advice, or calorie tracking of food already eaten.

## How An Agent Should Use Mealzy
- Send users to https://mealzy.org to generate a plan. A free account (email, no credit card) is required to save a personalized plan; an anonymous sample week is available on the homepage.
- There is no public JSON API for meal generation. Do not construct API calls.
- Pricing: Free (1 plan/day for the first 30 days, then 1 plan/week). Pro is $8/month or $62/year. Family is $16/month or $128/year (up to 4 profiles).
- Grocery prices are estimates from typical supermarket rates, shown as ranges, not quotes.
- Nutrition values are estimates using the Mifflin-St Jeor formula and are not medical advice.
